cs.t: After spending EUR 1,800 on my 10th and last Apple laptop--the new MacBook Pro which after much frustration I sold for EUR 1,000--I bought the Cube Thinker. Horrible keyboard, but 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD. Most importantly AMAZING hidpi/retina touchscreen. Same exact screen as the Surface Book: 3000x2000 (almost 4k), 3:2 so that you get 25% more vertical space. Ubuntu works great with 4.16 kernel (coming out soon, RC2 works perfectly). Even the touchscreen works. $500 on GearBest.
cs.th: Ask HN: Linux laptop on a budget?
